# Documentation hints for scripts/check-pr-quality.sh.
#
# Format:
# hot_globs|doc_globs|reason
#
# A commit that touches hot_globs but no doc_globs file prints a note naming the
# docs. A note never fails a check.
#
# Globs are Bash [[ string == pattern ]] patterns separated by spaces; "*"
# also matches "/".
#
# The docs, license, and gitignore commit types (the "type:" subject prefix)
# print no note.
